# Aurelia Bridges Counselling & Psychotherapy

> Private psychotherapy practice in Waterford, Ireland. Gestalt and integrative
> therapy for adults and couples, in person, online and by telephone.

## Practitioner
Aurelia Bridges, M.Psy., MIACP. Psychotherapist.
Accredited member of the Irish Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (IACP).
Graduate member of the Psychological Society of Ireland (PSI).

## Location
Unit 3, 1-2 Johnstown, Newtown, Waterford, X91 WN1N, Ireland.
Beside John's Bridge, a few minutes from Waterford city centre.
About a 15-minute walk from Waterford Bus Station.

## Services and fees
Individual therapy - EUR 80 per 60-minute session.
Couples therapy - EUR 100 per 60-minute session.
A limited number of reduced-fee places are available; enquire if cost is a barrier.
Sessions available in person, by secure video, or by telephone.

## Works with
Anxiety, depression, grief and loss, relationship difficulties, self-esteem,
trauma and PTSD, burnout. Adults and couples.

## Contact
Email counselling@aureliabridges.com - Phone and text 087 974 0021

## Not an emergency service
Counselling is not a crisis service. In an emergency contact 999 or 112,
Samaritans on 116 123, or Pieta House on 1800 247 247.
